WildSpark 2.2.51 fixes WildMaps settings access and the magnifier button position.

- Always show the WildMaps tab in the WildSpark menu. If its module files fail to initialize, the page now explains that instead of silently disappearing.
- Hold Ctrl and drag the WildMaps magnifier to move it around the minimap. Its position is saved between sessions.
- Reset both the enlarged minimap position and magnifier position from the WildMaps settings page.
- Use a built-in Classic-era spyglass icon.

The GitHub package workflow validates the release ZIP. Live behavior was not tested in a game client.
